basics.name: Dr. Maya Patel
basics.label: Staff Machine Learning Engineer & Data Scientist
basics.summary: Data Scientist & ML Engineer with 6+ years specializing in Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, recommender systems, and productionizing deep learning models on GPU clusters. PhD in Artificial Intelligence.

work.name: OmniAI Labs
work.summary: Tech lead for enterprise Generative AI workflows and hybrid retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems.
highlights: Designed and deployed enterprise RAG pipeline indexing 40M+ multimodal documents with Milvus and LangChain, improving answer recall from 64% to 92%.
Fine-tuned open-weights LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral) using LoRA and QLoRA on 8x H100 GPU clusters, cutting API inference costs by 68% ($320K/yr).
Published 2 peer-reviewed papers on hallucination suppression in retrieval systems.

work.name: Aether Data Systems
work.summary: Developed customer churn prediction and product recommendation algorithms.
highlights: Built two-tower recommendation model in PyTorch and Triton Inference Server, increasing click-through rate (CTR) by 19.4% across 8M MAU.
Created automated feature store and model drift monitoring pipeline using Feast and MLflow.
